mobile_verification.result: Local Chromium terminated at startup with SIGSEGV before any article navigation. No fresh mobile/desktop pass claimed for these three articles.

religious_review.result: Three new public articles retain explicit CMS noindex=true and are omitted from sitemap. No qualified Academics sign-off was found in inspected repository records. No indexing or religious-text change performed.

follow_up_read_only_audit.scope: Read-only CMS recheck, sitemap/robots/source inspection, and public archive observation. No CMS, site-code, production, analytics, or external-account writes.

cms_inventory.body_word_count_method: Postgres regexp_count over body_html after stripping HTML tags; counts alphanumeric sequences; excludes title, excerpt, navigation and footer.
cms_inventory.note: The nine articles without a body-level /free-trial link still receive the shared article-template CTA band; this was not classified as a missing CTA defect.

archive_and_indexing.public_visibility_risk: CONFIRMED: noindex controls search-result inclusion, not direct/public access. Because the archive query does not filter seo_noindex, published noindex posts can appear in the public blog archive after cache revalidation.
archive_and_indexing.public_archive_crawl_limit: Web cache showed pages 1–3 last crawled four days earlier; page 4 returned a cache miss. Fresh rendered archive count was not independently confirmed in this run.

issue_register.exact_evidence: CMS has status=published and seo_noindex=true for all three; there are zero rows with status=in_review. The 8 Nov register records HTTP 200 and noindex,follow for each. getPostPage filters only status=published and deleted_at IS NULL; it does not exclude seo_noindex. Qualified academic review remains pending.
issue_register.issue: Articles awaiting qualified academic review are already publicly reachable and eligible for public archive listing despite noindex.
issue_register.impact: Readers can access and share material before the intended academic approval gate; noindex only affects search-result inclusion.
issue_register.proposed_change: Owner decision: if academic review is a publication gate, change the three CMS records to draft/unpublished or implement an explicit reviewed-and-approved publication state that excludes them from public archive and direct article routes until sign-off.
issue_register.owner_access_needed: Owner decision, qualified Academic reviewer, and authorized CMS writer.
issue_register.risk: Editorial/religious-governance risk; no private student data exposure identified.
issue_register.approval_status: REQUIRES OWNER DECISION AND QUALIFIED ACADEMIC REVIEW
issue_register.verification_method: Record reviewer name, qualification, date and approved scope; then verify CMS status, archive omission, direct-route behavior, robots metadata and sitemap inclusion only after authorized change.

issue_register.exact_evidence: The three CMS records have no cover_url or cover_alt. The 8 Nov live HTML register confirms a shared fallback library image with alt text, 1200x800 dimensions and responsive srcset.
issue_register.issue: All three new articles reuse the same generic fallback cover instead of article-specific imagery.
issue_register.impact: Reduced visual specificity and weaker image relevance; not a missing-alt defect because rendered fallback alt is present.
issue_register.proposed_change: After academic approval, assign distinct, accurate, licensed/owned article covers and descriptive alt text; retain responsive delivery.
issue_register.owner_access_needed: Content owner and authorized CMS writer; image ownership/licensing evidence.
issue_register.risk: Low; avoid misleading or decorative imagery presented as factual.
issue_register.verification_method: Verify CMS cover URL/alt, rendered image dimensions/srcset, licensing record, mobile decode and no layout shift.

issue_register.exact_evidence: Read-only CMS query: author_id is NULL for 35/35 and author_name is 'Online Quran College' for 35/35; blog_posts schema has no reviewer field.
issue_register.issue: All posts use an organizational byline; no named individual author or academic reviewer is represented in the current CMS fields.
issue_register.impact: Limits visible subject-matter accountability and reviewer transparency, especially for Quran/Tajweed/Hifz/Tafseer guidance.
issue_register.proposed_change: Where genuine and consented, record the real content author and qualified academic reviewer with role, review date and scope. Do not invent names, qualifications or approval.
issue_register.owner_access_needed: Academic leadership and owner; CMS/schema owner if a reviewer field is approved.
issue_register.risk: Misrepresentation if credentials or reviewer approval are fabricated.
issue_register.verification_method: Check public byline/reviewer disclosure against signed-off internal evidence and current CMS version.

access_and_measurement.latest_prior_gsc_evidence: 7 Nov report says authenticated GSC page reports were retrieved for 22–28 Oct and 29 Oct–4 Nov; the detailed figures were in a private owner report not available in this run.
